detail.longDescription: Your Facebook page doubles as an inbox. Someone asks if an item is still in stock at 9 p.m., a customer wants to know where their order is, a prospect says "how much?" and then goes quiet. An AI agent can help you word the reply, but only while the chat is open. After that, somebody still has to watch Messenger, copy leads into the CRM, and flag the angry message before it sits overnight. Now you can automate Facebook Messenger from the AI tool you already use. Add Zapier to Claude, ChatGPT, or
